summary:
The vulnerable OIDC userinfo cache (token[:20] as cache key) was
introduced in v1.80.8 via commit 4d13035.
Our package is v1.78.0, which predates this feature entirely.
The true affected range is >= 1.80.8, < 1.83.0.
